card.name: Words after 'before/since/introduction of' time markers
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases that mark a starting point in time, such as 'Since the introduction of X in', 'Before the extensive use', 'When the gene was identified'. It fires on the word or small linking word just before a date or event is named.

modes.label: Since/before an introduction
modes.description: Linking word or noun after 'introduction of' or 'inception of' that is followed by a year.
modes.example: Since the introduction of diabetes drugs<< in>> the 1950s the

modes.label: Before an event began
modes.description: Word within a 'pre-' or 'before' phrase about when something started.
modes.example: Most pre<<state>>hood settlers of Colorado began arriving at the

modes.label: When something was identified
modes.description: Verb in a 'When X was identified' clause setting a point in history.
modes.example: When the CFTR gene was<< identified>>, he was among the first to examine
